description: This file defines the 'StatelessWorkerDirector' class which implements the 'IPlacementDirector' interface. It handles placement logic for stateless worker silos within the Orleans runtime, specifically determining the appropriate silo for activation based on compatibility and current silo status.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerDirector
classes.description: Implements the placement strategy for stateless workers, selecting appropriate silos for activation based on compatibility and runtime status.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the suitable silo for activating a new grain, prioritizing the local silo if compatible and not terminating, otherwise selecting randomly among compatible silos.
